name: unifi-controller
description: UniFi Network Controller with built-in MongoDB to manage Ubiquiti UniFi access points, switches and gateways. Web UI at https://<ip>:8443. Uses the floating 10.6 image tag, so updates pull the latest 10.6.x release - take a UniFi backup before upgrading, cross-major-version upgrades may require a restore.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: All UniFi controller data (configuration, sites, MongoDB database)

ports.name: Device communication
ports.description: Required for UniFi device communication and adoption

ports.name: L2 discovery
ports.description: Required for the 'Make controller discoverable on L2 network' option

ports.name: Guest portal HTTPS
ports.description: UniFi guest portal HTTPS redirect port

ports.name: Guest portal HTTP
ports.description: UniFi guest portal HTTP redirect port

ports.name: Speed test
ports.description: Used for the mobile throughput test

ports.name: Remote syslog
ports.description: Remote syslog port for UniFi devices

variables.description: Timezone for the controller, e.g. Europe/Berlin
